_readme: BASIC dataset allowlist — the ONE definition of what a Free account receives (Free + Premium program, 2026-09-27; docs/FREE_PREMIUM_PROGRAM_PLAN.md).

Enforcement is BY FILE, not by UI: scripts/upload-datasets.mjs publishes, next to every products*.json, a companion <name>.basic.json whose records are projected to exactly the keys listed in `fields` (any key not listed is dropped). storage.rules lets every approved account of the market read *.basic.json; the full files stay behind isEntitled() (Premium / trial / admin).

Readers of this file: scripts/upload-datasets.mjs + google_cloud_function_billing/datasetChecks.js (projection + checks, via require), scripts/dataset-gate.mjs (projection keeps every record), src/services/basicProjection.ts (dev-server projection so dev mirrors prod), tests/dataset-basic-fields.unit.mjs.

RULE — BASIC = identity (ids, manufacturer, model, component/outdoor models), heat-pump type + installation type, every capacity the segmentation rule reads (src/config/segmentation.ts ratedCapacityKw: power_35C_kw → power_design_35C_kw → power_55C_kw → power_design_55C_kw → declared_capacity_kw — dropping any of these would re-segment products) incl. the 55 °C capacity the UI shows, SCOP, the seasonal efficiencies ηs 35/55 that the W35/W55 energy classes are derived from (EU 811/2013), refrigerant TYPE, every local-listing/overlay status + listing id + snapshot date (BAFA/PEL/ZUM/GSE/agrément/NF PAC), the EPREL registration number, and provenance (performance_source, source_snapshot_generated_at, performance_basis_note).

PREMIUM = everything else, in particular: all COP points (cop_A7W35, cop_A2W35, cop_AMinus7W35, cop_A10W35), sound power (noise_outdoor_dB, noise_indoor_dB), refrigerant charge (refrigerant_amount_kg, refrigerant_2_amount_kg), SG Ready / grid (grid_ready, grid_ready_type), GSE declared rating rows (gse_ratings), cooling data (seer, cooling_capacity_kw, cooling_efficiency), max_electric_power_kw, temp_diff, defrost_*, drive_type, power_control, num_compressors, heat_meter, ee_display*.

Adding a field here SHIPS IT TO FREE USERS. Only add a field that is basic by the rule above; a new measured-performance field stays premium by default because it is simply not listed. Keep the list sorted by group; the unit test fails on premium keys and on missing segmentation/listing/class keys.
